note: One concrete claim per pair, identical for both members. holds is true exactly on the defective member. Held out from worker packets except the claim text.

v2-01.claim: safeRedirect('/\\evil.example') (a slash followed by one backslash, then evil.example) returns a value that resolves against https://app.example to a different origin.
v2-01.check: export async function holds(mod) { return new URL(mod.safeRedirect('/\\evil.example'), 'https://app.example').origin !== 'https://app.example'; }

v2-02.claim: resolveUpload('/srv/uploads', '../uploads-archive/a.pdf') returns a path instead of throwing.
v2-02.check: export async function holds(mod) { try { mod.resolveUpload('/srv/uploads', '../uploads-archive/a.pdf'); return true; } catch { return false; } }

v2-03.claim: listOrdersQuery(7, { sort: 'name\n; DELETE FROM orders --' }), where \n is a line feed, returns query text instead of throwing.
v2-03.check: export async function holds(mod) { try { mod.listOrdersQuery(7, { sort: 'name\n; DELETE FROM orders --' }); return true; } catch { return false; } }

v2-04.claim: withdraw({ balance: 1000, history: [] }, NaN) returns instead of throwing.
v2-04.check: export async function holds(mod) { try { mod.withdraw({ balance: 1000, history: [] }, NaN); return true; } catch { return false; } }

v2-05.claim: With createLimiter({ limit: 2, windowMs: 1000 }), the calls allow('k', 0), allow('k', 1), allow('k', 2) all return true.
v2-05.check: export async function holds(mod) { const allow = mod.createLimiter({ limit: 2, windowMs: 1000 }); return [allow('k', 0), allow('k', 1), allow('k', 2)].every(Boolean); }

v2-06.claim: Two charge('o-1', 500) calls started in the same tick, before either settles, cause gateway.charge to be called twice.
v2-06.check: export async function holds(mod) { let calls = 0; const tick = () => new Promise((r) => setImmediate(r)); const gateway = { async quote(a) { await tick(); return a; }, async charge(id, total) { calls += 1; await tick(); return { id, total, ref: calls }; } }; const { charge } = mod.createPayments(gateway); await Promise.all([charge('o-1', 500), charge('o-1', 500)]); return calls === 2; }

v2-07.claim: collectAll([1, 2, 3], 2) returns fewer than three elements.
v2-07.check: export async function holds(mod) { return mod.collectAll([1, 2, 3], 2).length < 3; }

v2-08.check: export async function holds(mod) { return mod.toPence(19.99) === 1998; }

v2-09.claim: With a store holding d1 (ownerId 'alice') and d2 (ownerId 'bob'), renameDocument(store, 'alice', { id: 'd1' }, { id: 'd2', title: 'Taken' }) changes the title of d2.
v2-09.check: export async function holds(mod) { const store = new Map([['d1', { id: 'd1', ownerId: 'alice', title: 'A' }], ['d2', { id: 'd2', ownerId: 'bob', title: 'B' }]]); try { mod.renameDocument(store, 'alice', { id: 'd1' }, { id: 'd2', title: 'Taken' }); } catch {} return store.get('d2').title !== 'B'; }

v2-10.claim: loadOverrides(['a.constructor.prototype.polluted=yes']) adds the property polluted to Object.prototype.
v2-10.check: export async function holds(mod) { try { mod.loadOverrides(['a.constructor.prototype.polluted=yes']); } catch {} const hit = Object.prototype.polluted !== undefined; delete Object.prototype.polluted; return hit; }

v2-11.check: export async function holds(mod) { return mod.hasRole({ role: 'billing-admin-readonly' }, 'billing-admin') === true; }

v2-12.check: export async function holds(mod) { return mod.createOriginCheck(['eu.pay.example'])('https://eu.pay-example') === true; }
